description: Molars, curved fangs and small incisors, no two from the same jaw. Palemaws and Emberjaws shed them constantly.
lore: Eight gold the mixed lot, and the mixing is the trade's teaching tool. Somebody tips a bag out on a cloth at a fire, the new ones go round the ring naming each tooth to its animal, whoever gets one wrong stands the next drink. It is a good evening. Everybody has had it.

There is a hard edge under the game and the old hands put it there deliberately. Two teeth in every bag are dog. One is off a [[monsters/undead_hound|Rotjaw]], which will stand at the head of a farm track for a hundred years and never come at you. The other is off a [[monsters/plague_hound|Blightcur]], which will lie down twenty paces off and not come at you either. A cracker who cannot tell those two apart on a cloth, in good light, with all the time in the world, will one day sit down and rest in the wrong company.
gm_notes: The apprenticeship of the junk trade, taught as a drinking game because that is the only way anybody learns it. The lesson is that neither dog attacks and one of them is still ruinous.
